image_description: A close-up shot of a toilet paper roll. The outer layers of the paper are printed with black musical notation (staves, notes, clefs), while the inner core and the far end of the roll appear to be plain white tissue. The paper is unrolled slightly, revealing the texture and the print.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of the toilet paper roll
artifact_observations.reasoning: The musical notation printed on the paper exhibits slight inconsistencies. Some staves warp unnaturally with the curvature of the roll, and some note heads appear slightly malformed or fused, which is common in AI-generated text/symbols.

artifact_observations.location: Transition between printed area and white area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition where the music print fades or ends looks slightly abrupt and lacks the natural bleed or ink absorption one might expect on porous tissue paper, appearing more like a digital overlay.
